mapper.select: SELECT , FROM review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN house h ON r.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN booking_order o ON r.order_id = o.id WHERE r.house_id = #{houseId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.creation_date DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, house_id, user_id, score, content, status, created_by, creation_date) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{houseId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET status = #{status}, modify_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
